name: Jalfrezi
subtitle: yesterday's roast turned into something better with chilli, onion and vinegar

ingredients.note: the dish exists to use up cold roast meat; raw chicken works but misses the point
the Anglo-Indian signature; it is what separates this from a stir fry

prepNotes: Jalfrezi is a leftovers dish by design. The name comes from a Bengali word for hot frying, and the method is fast and dry.
Everything is cut large and stays distinct. It should not collapse into a curry.

steps.text: Heat the oil until nearly smoking. Add the garlic and ginger and fry 30 seconds.
Add the onion petals and capsicum and fry on high 4 minutes. They should char at the edges and stay crisp.
steps.tip: High heat throughout. On low they sweat and go soft.

steps.text: Add the turmeric, cumin, chilli powder and green chillies. Toss 1 minute.
Add the cooked meat and tomato and fry 4 minutes until heated through and glossy.
Splash in the vinegar, let it hiss off, season and serve at once.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated but the vegetables soften. Reheat fast on high heat rather than gently.
